scope: Switch/Checkout owned full reference browser and single-commit Log routes. Complete app/browser/Log parity remains unfinished.

verification.source: CChooseVersion Branch browse uses PickRef all namespaces, reloads original selection on Cancel and chosen canonical ref on OK, then focuses selected combo. Commit browse uses typed revision Log SetParams, select/single-selection enabled and Working Tree suppressed. GitSwitchDlg OnVersionChanged reapplies new branch/tracking defaults.
verification.native: Final hidden native Switch receiver passes both Apple and bundled Git: actual all-reference browser includes tags/notes; local nested branch, tag, symbolic remote and notes handoffs retain canonical names and select correct Branch/Tag/Commit control. Strict popup/nonnil field-editor first responder checked; local/remote/tag/commit new-branch/tracking defaults and symbolic remote suggestion checked; unused commit draft and force/Merge retained.
verification.refresh: Late-created tag absent from parent catalog is discovered by actual native window performKeyEquivalent(F5 NSEvent) dispatch, then selected through a refreshed parent catalog. This does not prove physical key delivery.
verification.log: Actual full Log controller anchored at typed prior revision excludes newer HEAD and sibling commits; model graph and actual single-selection HistoryTableView match ancestry and no Working Tree row. Accept returns full hash and actual parent commit field-editor focus; Cancel preserves draft.
verification.ownership: Duplicate/cross-target/Checkout/reload/parent close/Quit locks, stale closed-reference and Log callbacks, rejected presentations, forced-parent cleanup for each picker and late callbacks/closed-parent reopening rejection are checked. HEAD/staged tree/config unchanged after fixture setup; no checkout is performed by picker receiver.
verification.context: Controller configuration delivers original-icon Log/Browse/Compare native menu actions with canonical selected reference; production RepositoryModel factory wires these to ordinary dialogs using retained repository/access. Tests capture callbacks rather than displaying follow-up windows.
verification.progress_regression: Existing real Switch progress receiver passes both Git engines: captured full options, three owner acknowledgement policies, remote tracking/detach/force/override, cross-name Continue capture, failed Retry, .gitmodules/once actions, owned No/Yes cancellation/fresh Retry, deferred completion, duplicate answers, missing presentation and hidden close/Quit. This receiver performs checkout only inside its private fixtures.
verification.reference_regression: Existing actual reference browser/Reset/Reflog native receiver passes both engines against final source, including packed exact Unicode choices, filters, context icons, owned Reflog and Reset locks/focus. No AttributeGraph cycles in final picker/reference receivers.
verification.repairs: Final review found absent production Switch factory context callbacks; added them and native configuration/action assertions. A guarded edit initially matched two distinct Switch factories and stopped before edits, then was scoped to the regular Switch factory. No native/compiler failures in final checks. Receiver strengthened with late-ref/F5/fresh-catalog and forced Log close cases; prior passing receiver log retained.
